title: Step 1: Two Starfleet Teams
text: Welcome to Subspace Intercept. You are divided into Team Alpha and Team Beta. Each team must crack a five-letter Starfleet override code.

title: Step 2: Transmit Three Clues
text: Each cycle, one Sender receives a secret word and transmits three one-word clues to their crewmates.

title: Step 3: Borg Assimilation
text: Before your crewmates see them, an opposing Borg operative assimilates one clue, replacing it with a decoy word.

title: Step 4: Call It Out & Crack the Code
text: Your crewmates call out their guess in person! If correct, reveal one letter of your code—or risk your turn to guess all five letters at once.

title: Step 5: Signal Lost
text: If you miss, the opposing team unlocks a letter instead. First team to complete their override code wins!
